handoffPurpose: Allow a new Codex session or a different AI account to maintain the production hospital leave-management system without losing operational context.

notes: Use npm run cf:deploy for production deployment.
Before deploy, verify npx wrangler whoami shows so7172@naver.com and account ID 17bcb091e79dc5a01cdcab39bc110c63.
After deploy, verify https://hospital-staff-leave-system-a6q.pages.dev responds with HTTP 200.
Do not use the old developer-owned Pages URL https://hospital-staff-leave-system.pages.dev.
Do not use the old developer-owned D1 database ID 5f524992-a63f-49a0-ad96-c0b9c09f3441.

mustDo: Read READ_FIRST_FOR_CODEX.md and this project-context.json before changing code.
Run npm test and npm run build after business logic changes.
Keep production DB changes targeted and review SELECT results before UPDATE or DELETE.
Commit and push production-relevant code changes to main when the user asks for GitHub sync.
mustNotDo: Do not reset, wipe, seed over, recreate, or bulk edit the production D1 database without explicit approval.
Do not run db:seed:remote against production.
Do not commit secrets, cookies, local temp files, or credentials.
Do not commit .tmp-* files, .claude/, .wrangler/, or real env files.
Do not use destructive Git commands such as git reset --hard unless explicitly requested.

loginRateLimit.reason: User requested removal; login attempts no longer lock or throttle accounts.

passwordFeatures: Admin/Director can reset employee passwords from employee edit.

approvalRules.finalApprovedCancel: Admin/Director and final approver logic exists in the approval route.

underOneYear.unpaidLeaveEffect: UNPAID leave overlapping a monthly accrual period blocks that month's monthly leave.

oneYearOrMore.rule: 15 days on work anniversary, +1 day every 2 years, max 25

leavePolicy.displayNote: SICK is a legacy enum currently used/displayed as public or official leave.

adminLeaveAdjustment.uiMeaning: Employee edit form leave field means target final remaining leave.
adminLeaveAdjustment.mobileNegativeInput: Use text input with decimal inputMode, not input type=number, so mobile keyboards can enter negative values.

recommendedWorkflow: Before deploying, run npx wrangler whoami and confirm the client Cloudflare account.
Deploy with npm run cf:deploy only when requested or clearly needed.
Commit and push to main when the user asks for GitHub sync.
